text:
zoe (Finance): Heads up Morning audit found ~USD 9.6k of GPU spend last night attributed to 'research-internal' but our internal mapping shows those hours were consumed by customer project 'nova-corp'. Cost UI: https://billing.internal/redwood/costs?range=24h&filter=research-internal

billing-bot: :warning: Allocation mismatch detected. Rule: SKU->team mapping divergence. Notifying #finance #finops #eng-platform

harry (FinOps): I pulled the billing export and vendor invoice. Vendor SKUs for gpu_v100_preemptible.us-west2 were recently renamed on vendor side (they appended a region suffix). Our ingestion mapping still matches old SKU names so those rows fell through and were assigned to fallback bucket 'research-internal'. Query I ran:  
```
SELECT sku_description, SUM(cost) FROM `billing_export.vendor_line_items` WHERE invoice_date = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY sku_description
```

kelly (Platform): We added a new ingestion stage last month that maps vendor SKU -> internal cost_bucket using a YAML file in infra-configs. Looks like vendor changed sku_description from "gpu_v100_preemptible" -> "gpu_v100_preemptible_us-west2" and we didn't have a fuzzy match. I'll open a quick patch to the mapper.

zoe (Finance): Can FinOps reassign the ~9.6k to nova-corp for the last 12 hours? Sales is already asking because the invoice draft shows lower credits. We need an audit trail for the reallocation.

harry (FinOps): Plan: 1) update SKU mapping in the ingestion config to include new vendor variants 2) re-run ingestion for the affected invoice window with the corrected mapping 3) verify BQ totals and cost UI deltas. Commands/steps:  
```
# update map (example entry)
# gpu_v100_preemptible_us-west2: gpu_v100_preemptible
# commit to infra-configs repo

# reingest
python tools/billing_ingest.py --start 2026-03-24T00:00:00Z --end 2026-03-24T12:00:00Z --mapping infra-configs/vendor-sku-map.yaml --dry-run
```

mae (Sales): Nova-corp finance already pinged me about missing credits. Please confirm ETA on reingest so I can tell them when to expect corrected invoice numbers.

vendor-bot: Vendor notification: CloudVendor SKU rename deployed 2026-03-23. See vendor release notes: https://vendor.cloud/status/renames

kelly (Platform): PR ready: Add vendor SKU variants + fallback fuzzy matcher. Link: https://git.internal/infra-configs/pull/804. I'll run dry-run ingest in staging now.

harry (FinOps): Dry-run results: mapping fixes reassign USD 9,598 from research-internal -> nova-corp for window 2026-03-24T00:00:00Z-2026-03-24T12:00:00Z. Backfill job id will be backfill-sku-2956 when promoted. I'll run the production reingest after Finance signs off.

zoe (Finance): Approve the reingest. Please include a changelog entry and the list of affected invoice line IDs. Finance will hold invoice until reingest completes and I'll update draft INV-NOVA-APR. Also add an alert to detect SKU name changes in vendor feed going forward.

harry (FinOps): Will do. Creating alert 'vendor-sku-renames' to notify #eng-platform and #finance on unexpected new sku_description values. Scheduling backfill job now.

billing-bot: Backfill job backfill-sku-2956 started. Notifying #finance.

kelly (Platform): Dry-run validated, promoting config to prod and running backfill. Deploy link: https://git.internal/infra-configs/commit/ae12f7

billing-bot: Backfill job backfill-sku-2956 completed. Delta: reallocated USD 9,598 from research-internal -> nova-corp for the affected window. Cost UI and invoice draft updated.

mae (Sales): Confirmed with customer contact; they see the corrected numbers in the draft. Thank you. I'll proceed with invoicing workflow per contract.

zoe (Finance): Thanks team. Closing this thread after audit log is attached to the invoice. Please keep the vendor-sku alert active for 30 days. :white_check_mark:
